items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: My favorite of mine was Hal Kemp in those days.

ctx.x:
That started me with lessons,
I was playing drums at the same time; there
was an organ around the house that my father
played. There was a phonograph with records
of Caruso--who else at that time--pretty
awful stuff.

The radio was just coming out
and I disobeyed all laws and stayed up until
the wee hours in grammar school, listening.
Ellington used to be on all the time. My
favorite of mine was Hal Kemp in those days.

Do you remember Hal Kemp from
North Carolina?
